combo.description: Trade without your ult by using E onto your target, then AA and quickly W Q. AA Q, AA Q, and AA to finish.
For a burst engage combo quickly E R, then Flash AA W. Q then AA, and finish with R Q.
To engage a fight for your team Q twice. Very quickly, use E R then Flash and Q onto your targets. AA R and W to finish.
For a nice trade AA Q, AA Q, AA Q. Then AA and instantly E W.
For your basic fast combo, AA Q, AA Q, AA Q then AA again.
For a fast trade use E W and Q in quick succession.
Commit to a fight by quickly using E towards your target, then R Q.
Chain your dash and stun by using E W instantly.
To ensure your ult damage hits your target, use your R2 and W them instantly.
When already in melee range use your R1 and W quickly to save on cast time.
To hide your ult animation, use E and R instantly.
